entries.title: Remember links its questions and offers a hint
entries.body: When Remember asks what you recall, its question is now meant to link to the passage that answers it and to come with a hint, kept behind a Hint button until you ask for it. So you can look instead of guessing, or take an easier clue first. This depends on how the AI words its reply, so expect it usually rather than every time. A hint you have opened stays open after a reload, and Copy answer leaves out a hint you have not opened.

entries.title: Debate shows who has cited the article
entries.body: On an article you added, Debate has a Cited by section: how many times the piece has been cited and a list of the works citing it, most cited first. It is looked up by the article's DOI in a public index of scholarly work, without the AI and without running Debate's own search, and a list appears only when the title and an author match. The privacy page names the indexes we ask. If you do not see Debate, turn on the Experimental features switch on your profile page.

entries.title: A publication year shows without an exact date
entries.body: When an article gives no publication date and the public record for the paper has only a year, the article's details and your library show that year alone. Sorting your library by Published places it at the start of that year. Visitors to a public article also see its journal and its publication date or year, where known.

entries.title: The reading-time chart is fainter, slower to fill
entries.body: The chart down the strip showing where you are in the article, which draws how long you have spent on each passage, is slightly fainter. It also takes far more time on a passage to reach full width, so a full-width mark is rarer and picks out the passages you stayed with longest.

entries.title: DOIs joined to a web address are found
entries.body: Some PDFs print a web address straight after the DOI with no space between them. We took the two together as the DOI, so the paper could not be found and its DOI, journal and publication date were left blank. The web address is now removed before the paper is looked up.
